Estimate the number of components in a window

estimate_rank.Rd

Combines several independent estimates of the chemical rank of a window's data matrix by majority vote.

Usage

estimate_rank(D, fid = NULL, methods = NULL, max_rank = NULL)

Arguments

D

Numeric matrix without missing values, scans x m/z (see extract_ms_matrix()).

fid

Optional list with numeric rt and intensity, one value per row of D (see .extract_fid_window()). Required when "fid" is in methods.

methods

Character vector, any of "fid", "svd", "bic", "pa". NULL uses the moosaic.rank_methods option.

max_rank

Positive integer upper limit. NULL uses the moosaic.rank_max option. Reduced to min(dim(D)) with a message if larger.

Value

A list with rank (integer, at least 1), confidence (share of usable votes equal to rank, in 0 to 1) and votes (named integer vector, one entry per method, NA when a method could not vote).

Details

Parallel analysis ("pa") is skipped when at least two of the other methods gave a usable vote and all of them agree; votes then has no pa entry. Votes above max_rank are capped. If the consensus is 0 (no method finds signal), rank is 1, confidence is the share of votes equal to 1, and a message of class no_signal is emitted. The "svd", "bic" and "pa" methods read their settings from moosaic.svd_var_threshold and moosaic.pa_iterations. "pa" uses random permutations; call set.seed() first for reproducible results. The optional background component is added later, not here.

Examples

set.seed(2615)
scan <- 1:40
C <- cbind(exp(-0.5 * ((scan - 12) / 3)^2), exp(-0.5 * ((scan - 22) / 3)^2))
S <- cbind(exp(-0.5 * ((1:30 - 8) / 3)^2), exp(-0.5 * ((1:30 - 20) / 3)^2))
D <- 100 * C %*% t(S)
estimate_rank(D, list(rt = scan, intensity = rowSums(C)))
#> $rank
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $confidence
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $votes
#> fid svd bic 
#>   2   2   2 
#>
